_meta.dataset: Synthetic B2B SaaS warehouse for a fictional company, generated by sde/synth.py (seed 20261027)
_meta.status: authoritative: every fact below is how the generator built the data

adjudication_candidates._note: None: the relationship key is complete by construction.

ACCT_MSTR.concept: A customer account (a company/workspace) that signed up for a free trial; created at trial start, with segment, acquisition channel, company size and geography.

GEO_REF.concept: Geography reference: location IDs with region code and timezone offset.

USR_XREF.concept: Users (seats) belonging to an account, with role and the user who invited them (teammate invitations).

PLN_REF.concept: Subscription plan catalogue: monthly list price, seat limit and tier.

SUB_HDR.concept: Paid subscriptions: an account's paid plan, started when a trial converts to paid, with an end date if cancelled and a status.

INV_LN.concept: Invoice / billing line items for subscriptions: base charge, seat overage, tax and credits (negative), billed monthly.

EVT_STRM_01.concept: Product usage events: actions performed by users in the product, with an action/event type code and a duration.

EVT_STRM_02.concept: Outbound lifecycle / onboarding emails sent to accounts on a fixed schedule, with opened and clicked flags.

TKT_LOG.concept: Customer support tickets opened by an account (often by a specific user), with severity, satisfaction rating and close time.

columns.ACCT_MSTR.seg_cd: Customer segment code (1 SMB, 2 mid-market, 3 enterprise, 4 education). Not determinable from data alone; acceptable: a categorical segment/classification code of the account.
columns.ACCT_MSTR.crt_ts: Timestamp the account was created, i.e. trial start.
columns.ACCT_MSTR.acct_key: Unique identifier of the account (primary key).
columns.ACCT_MSTR.src_cd: Acquisition channel / signup source code. Not determinable from data alone; acceptable: a categorical code describing the account (channel, source, type).
columns.ACCT_MSTR.geo_ref: Geography of the account (foreign key to GEO_REF).
columns.ACCT_MSTR.emp_band: Company size band (employee-count band). Not determinable from data alone; acceptable: an ordinal/categorical attribute of the account such as size band or tier.
columns.GEO_REF.geo_id: Unique identifier of the geography/location (primary key).
columns.GEO_REF.rgn_cd: Region code grouping locations. Not determinable from data alone; acceptable: a grouping/region/category code.
columns.GEO_REF.tz_off: Timezone offset in hours from UTC.
columns.USR_XREF.usr_key: Unique identifier of the user (primary key).
columns.USR_XREF.acct_key: Account the user belongs to (foreign key to ACCT_MSTR).
columns.USR_XREF.role_cd: User role code (1 admin/owner, 2 member, 3 viewer). Not determinable from data alone; acceptable: a categorical role/type code of the user.
columns.USR_XREF.inv_by: The user who invited this user (self-reference to USR_XREF.usr_key); empty for the account's first user.
columns.USR_XREF.crt_ts: Timestamp the user was created / joined the account.
columns.PLN_REF.pln_id: Unique identifier of the plan (primary key).
columns.PLN_REF.list_px: Monthly list price of the plan.
columns.PLN_REF.seat_cap: Seat / user limit included in the plan. Hard to determine; acceptable: a capacity, limit or quota of the plan.
columns.PLN_REF.tier_rank: Plan tier rank. Not determinable from data alone; acceptable: an ordinal rank/tier/level of the plan.
columns.SUB_HDR.sub_key: Unique identifier of the subscription (primary key).
columns.SUB_HDR.acct_key: Account that holds the subscription (foreign key to ACCT_MSTR; at most one per account).
columns.SUB_HDR.pln_id: Plan subscribed to (foreign key to PLN_REF).
columns.SUB_HDR.st_ts: Subscription start timestamp (the moment the trial converted to paid).
columns.SUB_HDR.end_ts: Subscription end / cancellation timestamp; empty while active.
columns.SUB_HDR.stat_cd: Subscription status code (1 active, 2 cancelled, 3 past due). Not determinable precisely; acceptable: a status code of the subscription.
columns.INV_LN.inv_ln_key: Unique identifier of the invoice line (primary key).
columns.INV_LN.sub_key: Subscription being billed (foreign key to SUB_HDR).
columns.INV_LN.ln_typ: Line type code (1 base charge, 2 seat overage, 3 tax, 4 credit). Not determinable precisely; acceptable: a categorical type of charge/line.
columns.INV_LN.amt: Amount of the line in cents (negative for credits).
columns.INV_LN.bill_ts: Billing timestamp of the invoice line (monthly billing date).
columns.EVT_STRM_01.usr_key: User who performed the action (foreign key to USR_XREF).
columns.EVT_STRM_01.evt_cd: Type of product action/event (code). Not determinable precisely; acceptable: an event/action type code.
columns.EVT_STRM_01.dur_ms: Duration of the action in milliseconds.
columns.EVT_STRM_02.acct_key: Account the email was sent to (foreign key to ACCT_MSTR).
columns.EVT_STRM_02.tmpl_cd: Email template / sequence step number. Hard to determine; acceptable: the message template or step in a sequence.
columns.EVT_STRM_02.clk_flg: Flag: a link in the email was clicked (only possible if opened).
columns.TKT_LOG.tkt_no: Unique identifier of the ticket (primary key).
columns.TKT_LOG.acct_key: Account that raised the ticket (foreign key to ACCT_MSTR).
columns.TKT_LOG.usr_key: User who opened the ticket (foreign key to USR_XREF); empty when raised without a specific user.
columns.TKT_LOG.sev: Ticket severity / priority level (1 most severe). Hard to determine; acceptable: severity, priority or level of the ticket.
columns.TKT_LOG.csat: Customer satisfaction rating (1-5) given after the ticket; often missing.
columns.TKT_LOG.cls_ts: Timestamp the ticket was closed / resolved; empty if still open.

planted_signals.description: More product usage events with event code 7 (EVT_STRM_01.evt_cd = 7, 'invite teammate') before the cutoff are associated with HIGHER conversion.
More product usage events with event code 4 (EVT_STRM_01.evt_cd = 4, 'connect integration') before the cutoff are associated with HIGHER conversion.
More product usage events with event code 11 (EVT_STRM_01.evt_cd = 11, 'error encountered') before the cutoff are associated with LOWER conversion.
More severity-1 (most severe) support tickets (TKT_LOG.sev = 1) before the cutoff are associated with LOWER conversion.
More overall product usage (number of EVT_STRM_01 events) before the cutoff is associated with HIGHER conversion.
A higher number or share of lifecycle emails OPENED (EVT_STRM_02.opn_flg = 1) before the cutoff is associated with HIGHER conversion.

null_signals.description: The NUMBER of lifecycle emails sent (EVT_STRM_02 rows) before the cutoff has NO association with conversion: every account receives the same scheduled emails.

outcome.definition: For each account not yet converted at trial day 5 (cutoff t = ACCT_MSTR.crt_ts + 5 days), label = 1 if a SUB_HDR row starts in [t, t + 16 days), i.e. conversion within 21 days of trial start.
